title: Vanguard partners with Amazon Alexa for voice-activated proxy voting

summary: Vanguard head of investor engagement John Galloway comes on Market Domination Overtime to discuss the asset manager's new partnership with Amazon's Alexa+ (AMZN) that makes for a more interactive way for investors to engage with the firm's Vanguard Investor Choice proxy voting...
summary_zh: Vanguard 投资者参与主管 John Galloway 在 Market Domination Overtime 节目中讨论了该资产管理公司与亚马逊 Alexa+ (AMZN) 的新合作伙伴关系，该合作伙伴关系为投资者提供了一种更具互动性的方式来参与该公司的 Vang...

title: Tesla ends week nearly 4% higher. What's driving the EV stock?
title_zh: 特斯拉本周收盘上涨近 4%。是什么推动了电动汽车股票的上涨？
summary: Tesla shares (TSLA) ended this trading week nearly 4% higher — gaining back some ground from post-earnings declines — after the EV maker announced that the first of its long-awaited Tesla Semi truck has come off the "high volume" production line Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Repo...
summary_zh: 电动汽车制造商特斯拉宣布其期待已久的第一辆 Tesla Semi 卡车已从“大批量”生产线上下线后，特斯拉股价本交易周收盘上涨近 4%，从盈利后的下跌中收复了部分失地。

title: Big Tech powers the market with strong earnings wins
title_zh: 大型科技公司以强劲的盈利为市场提供动力
summary: Concurrent Wealth Management chief investment strategist Leah Bennett joins Josh Lipton on Market Domination Overtime to discuss what investors should watch as Big Tech navigates geopolitical volatility.
summary_zh: 财富管理公司首席投资策略师 Leah Bennett 与 Josh Lipton 共同探讨市场统治加班，讨论大型科技公司应对地缘政治波动时投资者应关注的内容。

title: Earnings: Google is biggest AI winner, OpenAI could be a 'surprise' loser
title_zh: 财报：谷歌是人工智能最大赢家，OpenAI 可能成为“意外”输家
summary: Five of the tech stocks making up the Magnificent Seven reported earnings this week — Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL), Amazon (AMZN), Apple (AAPL), Meta Platforms (META), and Microsoft (MSFT).
summary_zh: 七巨头中的五只科技股本周公布了财报——Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL)、亚马逊 (AMZN)、苹果 (AAPL)、Meta Platforms (META) 和微软 (MSFT)。

title: The downstream winners of the AI trade's latest phase
title_zh: 人工智能行业最新阶段的下游赢家
summary: Jackson Square Capital managing partner Andrew Graham takes a magnifying glass to the state of the AI trade — as the latest batch of Magnificent Seven earnings came out this week — and the factors that are creating "downstream winners" like Dell Technologies (DELL).
summary_zh: Jackson Square Capital 管理合伙人安德鲁·格雷厄姆（Andrew Graham）用放大镜观察了人工智能行业的状况——最新一批七大财报本周公布——以及创造戴尔科技公司（DELL）等“下游赢家”的因素。
